text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whew...! Tannhauser, you're looking 
awfully energetic today~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Today is a slightly special day... 
It's 'Munmun Day,' after all."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Munmun Day" is a day where my family's 
shop gives away free side dishes. Like 
meatballs, or fried chicken.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, I was so busy helping out too. 
Whenever it's discount day, my body just 
gets all pumped up with a 'Mun-mun!' on 
its own."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And so... today, I'm even going to ask for 
seconds on training!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, don't push yourself too 
hard...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't see anything anymore. 'Munmun 
Day' is truly terrifying..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser was even more fired up 
than usual; after her run, it seemed she 
even completed some extra training 
routines.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Watch out, right there! There's a dip in 
the ground!"
